description: Restoration Shaman-style healer with a Discipline wrinkle - Energy-fueled ranged attacks pay back mana while Aspect of the Goddess turns damage into ally healing.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Moonwell Splash, Elune's Purification, Hand of Elune, Moonflow, Tidal Rebirth confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Lunar Phase (stacks from crits), Scattered Star (built by Huntress Shot), and Moonwater (applied by heals) all interlock - Aspect of the Goddess turns ranged damage and Scattered-Star consumption into ally healing, so this spec fights and heals at the same time.

nodes.name: Lunar Devotion
nodes.description: Increases healing spell power and hit rating from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Moon Priest - Level 15 Passive. Healing spell power + hit rating from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Moon Touch
nodes.description: Increases all healing done by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Flow of Waters
nodes.description: Increases party and self critical strike chance. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid + self crit chance buff (no stacking with similar).'

nodes.name: Astral Knowledge
nodes.description: Increases Intellect by 3 per rank.

nodes.name: Teachings of Elune
nodes.description: Increases Hand of Elune and Moonflow healing by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Moon Gazing
nodes.description: Critical strikes generate a Lunar Phase stack.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive. Crits generate a Lunar Phase stack (limited frequency).' Feeds Rapid Cycle's ranged haste-per-stack mechanic.

nodes.name: Prayer of Elune
nodes.description: Learn Prayer of Elune, healing up to several allies and dispelling harmful magic from them.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, Sentinel(1) tag despite the healing flavor - 'healing up to 12 allies within 40 yds for 173, and dispel 1 harmful magic effect from them.' Moon Priest's real party heal+cleanse.

nodes.name: Aspect of the Goddess
nodes.description: Increases healing done, guarantees your spells and abilities cannot miss, and causes consuming Scattered Stars to heal nearby allies. Only 1 Aspect active at a time.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's signature identity mechanic: 'Boosts healing done; spells/abilities can't miss; consuming Scattered Stars heals nearby allies.' Turns ranged damage into a real healing stream.

nodes.name: Rippling Moonwater
nodes.description: Healing applies a stacking Moonwater effect to the target.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Healing applies stacking Moonwater to target.' Part of the interlocking stack system alongside Lunar Phase and Scattered Star.

nodes.name: Rapid Cycle
nodes.description: Each Lunar Phase stack increases your ranged haste.

nodes.name: Moon Priest
nodes.description: Huntress Shot's Lunar Eclipse effect now applies 2 additional Scattered Stars.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Huntress Shot's Lunar Eclipse applies 2 additional Scattered Stars.'

nodes.name: Cycle of the Moon
nodes.description: Cycles between Full Moon and New Moon periodically, altering Hand of Elune's behavior.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Cycles between Full Moon and New Moon periodically.' Full Cycle talent (Full Moon boosts healing, New Moon reduces cost) layers on top of this base cycle.

nodes.name: Moonlit Slumber
nodes.description: Learn Moonlit Slumber, putting an enemy to sleep and draining their mana over time. Damage ends the effect.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Sleep + mana drain over time; damage ends it.' Real long single-target CC.

nodes.name: Cosmic Shift
nodes.description: Learn Cosmic Shift, phasing a target ally into improved stealth. Does not break on damage.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Phases target ally into improved stealth; doesn't break on damage.'

nodes.name: Celestial Form
nodes.description: Increases critical strike chance; critical strikes reduce healing spell cooldowns and apply a Scattered Star to nearby targets, for a window.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Moon Priest's real burst-healing cooldown, used pre-burst and to accelerate heal cooldowns per the dungeon writeup.

nodes.name: Celestial Awakening
nodes.description: Learn Celestial Awakening, a battle resurrection that restores health, mana, and boosted mana regeneration. Usable out of combat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Battle-rez with health + mana + boosted mana regen. Out of combat.'

nodes.name: Moonwater Blessing
nodes.description: Learn Moonwater Blessing, healing an ally and increasing their Armor while reducing their costs, scaling with Lunar Phase stacks.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Heal + boosts target's Armor + reduces their costs; scales with Lunar Phase stacks.'

nodes.name: Stellar Convergence
nodes.description: Applies Eclipsing Arrows to the party and raid, letting a Sentinel's Huntress Shot heal them.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Applies Eclipsing Arrows to party/raid.' Cross-spec synergy with Sentinel's Eclipsing Arrows mechanic.

nodes.name: Lunar Resplendence
nodes.description: Increases healing done to allies below 20% health.

nodes.name: Gentle Waters
nodes.description: Increases Moonwell Splash and Silverstream healing by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Blessed Starlight
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Flowing Grace
nodes.description: Increases Prayer of Elune and Silverstream critical heal chance by 2% per rank.
